guide_enrichment.narrative:
We are not ignoring Syracuse’s 66-3 opener, which included five sacks, three takeaways and no turnovers. We also do not treat one dominant result against New Hampshire as proof that the underlying matchup has changed. Our numbers still identify Syracuse’s pass defense as vulnerable, while Connecticut’s passing offense is one of the stronger units in our ratings. We also see Connecticut holding an advantage when it runs the ball, giving the home offense more than one credible path to stay competitive.

Our main concern is Syracuse quarterback Steve Angeli. We saw him return from his season-ending injury to throw for 263 yards in the opener, and he produced a career-high 416 yards against Connecticut last season. Even so, our broader numbers view Syracuse’s passing offense much less favorably than Connecticut’s pass defense. For us, the case is less about dismissing Syracuse’s opening performance and more about the market pricing too much separation despite matchup advantages that should allow Connecticut to answer offensively. That is why we are backing Connecticut with the points.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are focused on Connecticut’s passing offense against Syracuse’s pass defense. Syracuse generated pressure and takeaways in the opener, but our longer-run ratings still show a substantial advantage for Connecticut through the air. If Connecticut can avoid allowing Syracuse’s pass rush to dictate the game, we think the home offense can create enough efficient possessions to keep the margin within our expected range.

recent_game.fact: Syracuse opened the 2026 season with a 66-3 win over New Hampshire.
Syracuse scored 41 first-half points and had five different players score a rushing or receiving touchdown against New Hampshire.
The Orange allowed 159 total yards, recorded five sacks and made nine tackles for loss against New Hampshire.
Syracuse gained three takeaways and committed no turnovers in the opener.

quarterback.fact: Starting quarterback Steve Angeli returned from his 2025 season-ending injury and passed for 263 yards against New Hampshire.
Angeli has passed for at least 230 yards in six consecutive games and has never thrown for fewer than 245 yards in a Syracuse appearance.
Angeli threw for a career-high 416 yards on 34-of-54 passing against UConn in 2025.
The projected quarterback depth chart lists Angeli first, followed by Amari Odom or Malachi Nelson.

offensive_personnel.fact: True freshman running back Shavane Anderson Jr. rushed 10 times for 102 yards and three touchdowns in his collegiate debut against New Hampshire.
Running back Tylik Hill started the opener and recorded 91 rushing yards and his first collegiate touchdown.
Wide receiver Umari Hatcher set career highs with eight receptions, 147 receiving yards and two touchdowns against New Hampshire.
Tight end David Clement caught two passes for a career-high 35 yards, including his first collegiate touchdown, in the opener.
Syracuse's projected offensive line is Trevion Mack at left tackle, Oluwafunto Akinshilo at left guard, Joe Cruz at center, Byron Washington at right guard and Kam Pringle at right tackle.
The offensive line received an 87.0 pass-blocking grade from PFF in the opener, second best among ACC teams through Saturday's games.
Center Joe Cruz has appeared in 38 games with 17 starts and has allowed one sack in 657 pass-blocking opportunities, according to PFF.
Akinshilo, a 2026 transfer, made his first career start at left guard against New Hampshire.

defensive_personnel.fact: Transfer edge defender Keyshawn Johnson recorded 2.5 sacks, four tackles and a forced fumble in his Syracuse debut.
Four of Syracuse's five sacks against New Hampshire were recorded by transfers.
Defensive lineman Rashard Perry recorded three tackles and his first career interception against New Hampshire.
Defensive back Chris Peal led Syracuse with four solo tackles and allowed 14 receiving yards when targeted against New Hampshire, according to PFF.

The projected defense includes four transfers among the listed first-team front seven: Tunmise Adeleye, Keyshawn Johnson, Chris D'Appolonia and Oluwafunto Akinshilo is not on defense; the defensive first team otherwise lists Nissi Ogbebor, Rashard Perry and Antoine Deslauriers.

coaching_changes.fact: Vince Kehres is in his first season as Syracuse's defensive coordinator.
Jeff Nixon is Syracuse's offensive coordinator and calls the offense from the booth.
Juan Castillo is in his first season as Syracuse's offensive line coach.
Alex Bayer is in his first season as Syracuse's special-teams coordinator.

injury_availability.fact: Angeli returned against New Hampshire after suffering a season-ending injury in the fourth game of the 2025 season.
Hatcher returned in 2026 after missing the entire 2025 season because of injury.
Freshman wide receiver Calvin Russell III is expected to return to the field in October.
Perry played in the 2026 opener after a season-ending injury limited him to five games in 2025.

offensive_context.fact: Ten Syracuse players caught at least one pass against New Hampshire.
Syracuse converted 66.7 percent of its third downs in the season opener.
Syracuse produced 32 first downs and possessed the ball for 32:34 against New Hampshire.
The Orange were penalized 12 times for 125 yards in the opener.

defensive_context.fact: Syracuse did not allow a touchdown against New Hampshire and surrendered only three points.
Twenty-four Syracuse defenders recorded at least one tackle against New Hampshire, and nine players contributed at least half a tackle for loss.
Syracuse held New Hampshire to 60 rushing yards and 99 passing yards.

special_teams.fact: Davien Kerr blocked a punt against New Hampshire that went through the end zone for a safety.
Demetres Samuel Jr. returned four punts for 83 yards, averaging 20.8 yards per return, against New Hampshire.
Kicker Tripp Woody made a 34-yard field goal in the opener and is 11-for-11 on career attempts inside 40 yards.
Syracuse's previous blocked punt before the 2026 opener came against UConn on Sept. 6, 2025, when Denis Jaquez Jr. deflected a punt.

series_context.fact: Syracuse defeated UConn 31-24 in 2024 and 27-20 in overtime in 2025.
Fran Brown is 2-0 as Syracuse's head coach against UConn.

other_relevant.fact: The 2026 schedule lists Syracuse at UConn on Oct. 3 with a noon kickoff.
